claims.head: A shadow job for Rosén, Lowry and Mercer
claims.call: The Jets’ L2 (Rosén, Lowry and Mercer) spends at least 51% of its 5-on-5 time against the Panthers’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Jets keep sending Mercer’s line (Rosén, Lowry and Mercer) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Scott Arniel has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Panthers’ first line is B. Tkachuk, Bennett and M. Tkachuk.
claims.nums: At home: 51% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 36% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Scott Arniel likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Panthers’ first line.

chips.tip: Winnipeg’s L2 (Rosén, Lowry and Mercer) at home: 51% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ first lines. Matchups, Winnipeg home games this season, 6 games, 32 minutes for this group at 5-on-5.
With no line matching, this group would face first lines about 36% of the time, about as often as those lines are on the ice.

Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 8 games. He is a top-six forward.

WPG.head: The Jets start a half-step behind
WPG.body: Florida has been out-chancing opponents lately, while Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. Then again, Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, and Florida will be without Barkov. The Jets can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

FLA.head: The Panthers start a half-step ahead
FLA.body: Florida has been out-chancing opponents lately, while Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. Then again, Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, and Florida will be without Barkov. Still, it’s close: the Jets can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: The Jets are searching for answers
paras: The Jets are winless in five (0-3-2). The Panthers are 6-4-2.
